description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Omni-Changeling.
Activate Omni-Changeling by tapping it.
When Omni-Changeling becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Omni-Changeling's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Omni-Changeling
uses.cardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness
